title: Azo substituent effects: charge and azo-bond dissociation energy
difficulty_reasons: Two fixed molecules and observables are specified, but conformer, method, charge partitioning, and radical-fragment validation require independent choices.

paper.title: Substituent-Driven Electronic Modulation of Azo Bond: Enabling the Design of Ultrafast and Exceptionally Sensitive Fluorescent Probe for Hypoxia

data.description: Explicit canonical SMILES and state/mapping definitions for two neutral closed-shell azo molecules.

required_deliverables.description: Structured per-molecule calculations, validation, comparison, and limitations.
